title: Release pipeline: run the tests before publishing and pin every action to a fixed version
summary: The release workflow now runs the front-end and Rust suites first and publishes only when they pass; every third-party action is pinned to a commit hash, and a new CI check rejects moving tags. The first release after the merge still has to be confirmed to carry all four files.
friction: The macOS release job of v0.3.162 was cancelled for lack of a GitHub runner, so latest.json listed only Windows and Mac copies got an update error; fixed by re-running the failed job, which is the second time this has happened — an automatic retry would save the next run the diagnosis
lessons_learned: A trial release run from a branch shares the release concurrency group, so it queues behind a stuck main release
